definition: a plot of ground where plants are growing
description: Two young people work outdoors in a sunny hillside garden, bent over a long raised wooden bed filled with dark soil. He presses small green seedlings into the soil one by one while she loosens the earth beside him with a hand trowel, and a row of identical seedlings appears down the length of the bed. A wide shot shows several parallel raised beds, one of them already planted, and the two of them stepping back with their tools to look at the finished rows.
